tasks.title: Make theme toggle icon white in dark mode
tasks.description: 1. WHAT: Set the theme toggle icon color to white when dark mode is active, so the Sun/Moon lucide-react icon is visible against the dark calculator background. 2. READ FIRST: src/components/Calculator.css (current .theme-toggle styles at lines 24-50 — no color property is set). 3. FILES: Modify src/components/Calculator.css only — add a `[data-theme='dark'] .theme-toggle { color: #ffffff; }` rule after the existing `.theme-toggle:focus` rule (after line 50). 4. APPROACH: The `.theme-toggle` button renders lucide-react SVG icons (Moon/Sun) whose stroke color inherits from the CSS `color` property. Adding `color: #ffffff` scoped to `[data-theme='dark'] .theme-toggle` will make the icon white in dark mode without affecting light mode. The `data-theme` attribute is set on the `.app` div in App.tsx (line 30). 5. PATTERNS: Follow the existing `[data-theme='dark']` selector override pattern already used in App.css (lines 59-81).
acceptance_criteria: The theme toggle icon (Sun/Moon) appears white (#ffffff) when dark mode is active
The theme toggle icon color is unchanged in light mode
